messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands in profile, then raises both arms overhead and swings them in a large circular motion before lowering them back to his sides.","camera":"A static, medium shot from the side at roughly waist-to-head height, keeping the subject centered against the background.","clothing":"A white long-sleeved shirt with a faint grid pattern, sleeves rolled to the elbows, worn with tan leather suspenders and dark jeans.","hair_color":"Deep red or maroon.","hairstyle":"Short, faded sides with a longer, swept-up top styled into a pompadour.","identity":"A young man with a slim build and light brown skin, shown in profile and three-quarter views.","scene":"An outdoor paved area beside a metal guardrail, with a rocky hillside, green trees, and a utility pole under a bright, partly cloudy sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from an indoor/industrial metal wall with a train-like structure to an outdoor paved roadside area with a guardrail, rocky hillside, trees, and a utility pole, matching the reference. The man’s red pompadour, white grid shirt, tan suspenders, dark jeans, profile pose, and arm-raising action remain largely consistent, and the camera remains a static medium side shot.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original scene with the reference environment while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the new background matches the reference exactly in all details, since the person occludes part of the scene.
unexpected_changes: The person’s lighting and color grading changed to brighter outdoor daylight, with stronger shadows and highlights.
